_note: Retrieval profiles per task (P-37, C-29 point 5): which collections each task may draw evidence from and how many passages. Only published sources and approved, non-illustrative reviewed examples are ever returned; current bid evidence only for its own bid. Market and vendor context is in no profile: it is never verified evidence. values_only keeps passages whose annotations state a value (numerical comparisons). component_evidence (P-58) cites the supplied product documents beside each requested component of the configurator; response_drafting leaves out bid evidence because the outline prompt already gives each answer's RFP wording. A change here is a change of the retrieval, recorded with every assessment (profile hash).
